main_text.p: fermento imbutainfalubria esse, quin & co-quendi apparandique modo. Videmus ple-runque, quod foris eft retorridum, intus effe incoctum, ideoque vix conficiuntur, ftoma-cho enim negotium faceffunt, crudumque fuccum ac flatus generant.

Lauda-tiffima panificia & fala-berrima.Fiunt quoque panificia celebratiffima ex medulla tritici aqua vinoque albo diligen-ter macerata agitataque, deinde ouorum lu-teis pluribus adiectis, fale modico ac faccha-ro: ferramenta autem habent peculiaria, qui hos panes expetunt, non tam alte, neque tam patenter exsculpta, sed tantum ad fauo-rum rudimenta, quæ oleo aut butyro illinun-tur, Germani vocant Kuchenfen / Eifenku-chen.
Apud quosdam ex similagine, alios ex polline tritici conflantur opera piftoria, bu-tyro, ouis, lacte, melle aut faccharo fubigen-tes, quidam crocum adiiciunt, guftuque lunt fuauiffima.

Alii fimilam triticeam adiecto melle aut faccharo fubigunt, quibus poftea cinnamo-mum, piper, aliaque id genus confunduntur. Quidam anifum, fœniculum & cymi-num infpergunt, grati optimique lapo-ris, quibus etiam communis nofter pa-nis filigineus falubriter perfpergi poteft.

page.notes: The left margin note is set in four short lines with hyphens at the line ends ("Lauda-", "tiffima", "panificia", "& fala-", "berrima."); the hyphen is kept as printed. The black-letter words "Kuchenfen / Eifenkuchen" are rendered in Latin letters here, with long s as s. Doubtful: "rür" at the start of the line, read as "rur" with no mark; "lunt" in "guftuque lunt", possibly "iunt"; "Eifenku-chen" split at the line end as printed. The first paragraph continues from the previous page.
